function.name: search_internet
function.description: Searches the live public internet using SearXNG. Returns relevant web page titles, URLs, and text snippets.

query.description: Search terms or keywords to query.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default: 8, max: 50).

time_range.description: Filter results by time range (e.g. 'day' for latest 24 hours).

function.name: get_news_and_events
function.description: Retrieves recent news and world events for a topic, and provides an executive briefing with numbered citations [n].

topic.description: The news subject, geopolitical event, or headline topic.

max_results.description: Maximum number of news articles to retrieve (default: 8).

function.name: read_website
function.description: Fetches a web page URL and extracts the clean body text, stripping ads, scripts, and navigation. Protected against SSRF and capped at 5MB.

url.description: The full HTTP/HTTPS URL of the web page to read.

max_chars.description: Maximum extracted character count before truncation (default: 8000).

summarize.description: Set to true to also produce a concise AI summary of the page contents.

function.name: deep_research
function.description: Conducts multi-step deep research on a question: generates sub-queries, executes parallel searches, extracts text across diverse domains, and writes a structured report with [n] citations.

question.description: The complex research question or topic to investigate in depth.

depth.description: Research depth: 'quick' (3 sub-queries), 'standard' (5 sub-queries), or 'deep' (8 sub-queries).

function.name: verify_fact
function.description: Rigorously verifies a factual claim against live external evidence. Searches confirming and refuting perspectives and returns a verdict (TRUE, MOSTLY_TRUE, MIXED, MOSTLY_FALSE, FALSE, UNVERIFIABLE) with confidence and quote summaries.

claim.description: The specific statement or factual assertion to verify.

function.name: crawl_website
function.description: Recursively crawls multiple pages of a website/documentation up to a max depth and page count with strict SSRF filtering, extracting body text and optional synthesized knowledge.

url.description: The starting root web page URL.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (default: 10, range: 1-30).

stay_on_domain.description: Whether to restrict crawling strictly to the root domain (default: true).

summarize.description: Whether to generate an aggregated LLM summary of all crawled pages.
